Subject: Vendor activation: invoice metadata, subject token, and onboarding form

Hi Vanessa,

We're finalizing vendor setup for Greenline Logistics and I have a couple of quick questions about your invoice submission process so we don't hit delays on our first payout.

1) Portal vs email: do you prefer we use the vendor portal? If so, can you send the registration link we should distribute to AP?
2) Email fallback: if we email invoices, what subject token and header format do you need so your AP system will auto-match POs?
3) Multiple POs: can we attach a single PDF that contains multiple invoices tied to different POs, or do you require one file per PO/invoice?
4) Template/fields: which fields are mandatory in CSV/XML/PDF for automatic PO matching?

I've attached a sample PDF from our ERP for reference (sample_invoice_greenline_110.pdf). Also: for contractor/subcontractor invoices that sometimes arrive without a PO, what's the required metadata so you can route them to the right remit entity?

Thanks — please loop in whoever needs to be on your side.

Best,
Alejandra Ruiz
Accounts Payable
Greenline Logistics

Attachment: sample_invoice_greenline_110.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: invoice metadata, subject token, and onboarding form

Hi Alejandra —

Thanks for sending the sample — helpful. Short answers up front and a small example payload below.

- Preferred path: vendor portal is preferred because it gives immediate acknowledgements, structured mapping, and faster PO matching. Portal link (one-time registration): https://redwood.app/onboard/vendor-registration/GLN-12345
- Email fallback: acceptable to invoices@invoices.redwood.com. Please include the subject token GLN-<vendor-id> in the subject (e.g., "GLN-12345 invoice 2026-11-30"). That token wires your emails to the right vendor record.
- Subject/header rules: place a header line or subject field with PO numbers; we accept multiple PO values separated by a pipe (|) or semicolon. If you have multiple invoices in one PDF, ensure each invoice shows an invoice_number and the associated PO number on the invoice page itself.
- File types: PDF (PDF/A preferred), CSV, or XML are fine. For automatic ingest CSV/XML needs the fields below. If you send only scanned PDFs, our OCR team can extract fields but processing will be slower and may require manual QC.

Minimal required fields for auto-matching (CSV/XML element names shown):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- total_amount (USD)
- po_number
- remittance_entity_id (the remit-to entity that should be paid)
- tax_id (optional but helps remit routing)
- line_items (optional for CSV; required only for three-way match cases)

Example CSV header (single-line):
"invoice_number,invoice_date,total_amount,po_number,remittance_entity_id,tax_id,line_items"
Sample: 110,2026-11-30,4520.00,PO-98765|PO-98766,GLN-REMIT-02,12-3456789,"SKU:AC-9:2:200.00;SKU:MK-2:1:120.00"

Contractor/subcontractor invoices without PO: include "PO" set to "N/A" and provide remittance_entity_id and tax_id so we can route to the right ledger. If neither is present we'll hold for manual review which delays payment.

Monica — can you enable alias GLN-12345 and add invoices@invoices.redwood.com to the inbound whitelist for greenline.co?

I've attached a compact CSV template that maps to the headers above.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_template_sample.csv (text/csv)

Hi Alejandra —

I pulled your XML and our onboarding team confirmed it's compatible as long as those XML elements are present. Mapping guidance: <InvoiceID> -> invoice_number, <InvoiceDate> -> invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), <TotalAmount> or <Total> -> total_amount, <PO> -> po_number (we'll split multiple PO nodes into pipe-separated values). If your XML uses different element names we can accept a simple mapping file or you can convert to CSV — either works.

Regarding tax information: numeric tax_id is preferred for automated routing. If you only provide a tax classification string we will accept it but it will flag for manual routing in a small percentage of cases. To avoid delays please include numeric tax_id in the vendor registration form.

Monica — please confirm the GLN-12345 alias is enabled and greenline.co is whitelisted on the invoices endpoint. Once that's done Alejandra can run a couple of test emails and we'll validate auto-matches.

Vendor registration link (again): https://redwood.app/onboard/vendor-registration/GLN-12345

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

[Internal note to Monica: after we confirm whitelist, assign a one-time preflight to the ingestion team to validate sample XML -> CSV mapping for Greenline.]
